# Flame v2.6.4

## Clock fonts
- Add **DSEG7 Classic** with regular and bold seven-segment LCD faces.
- Add **Matrix Mono Screen** with separated square pixels in a monospaced 5×7 grid.
- Remove Doto from the bundled Docker image, CSS and font selector. Previously saved Doto settings display Matrix Mono Screen and switch to that selection when Interface settings are saved.
- Preserve font source licenses in the Docker image. Optional user-installed clock fonts remain supported.

## Mobile layout
- Make the weather widget visible on mobile, with **Auto** clock size as the default to keep clock and weather side by side.
- Balance the spacing above and below the large clock and avoid overlap with quotes and the Settings link.
- Disable mobile viewport zoom as requested.

## Quality and documentation
- Update the README, Docker Compose example, font setup and testing instructions.
- Extend browser checks for mobile spacing, bundled fonts and removed-font compatibility.
